pr.title: feat(core): clean up expired Administration password recovery entries
pr.body: Administration password recovery hashes are valid for two hours, but their `user_recovery` rows stay in the database until the user requests a new one. Adds the daily `user.cleanup_user_recovery` scheduled task, which deletes entries older than 48 hours in batches of 1000, the same way `CleanupCustomerRecoveryTaskHandler` does for customers.
pr.author: synthetic
